svg.title: ChemGridMap overview and enlarged molecular structures
svg.desc: 889 CA II molecules occupy their archived grid cells. The blue box identifies the nine cells enlarged on the right, in the same order. Activity classes and median pChEMBL values are shown for each structure.
svg.text: From a chemical map to individual molecules

Structures, cell positions and median values are retained.
